name: Per-Gaussian Backward
definition: A backward pass optimization that operates on buckets of 32 Gaussians (one warp) to efficiently compute gradients using warp-level primitives.
summary: Per-Gaussian Backward optimizes 3D Gaussian Splatting by parallelizing gradient computation over 32-Gaussian buckets using shared memory and warp-level primitives to reduce atomic contention and global memory latency.
